Interface EnumeratedCodedValue<T extends CodedValueType>

All Superinterfaces:
CodedValueType, EnumeratedValueSet<T>, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ActiveParticipantRoleIdCode, AuditSourceType, EventIdCode, EventTypeCode, FhirEventIdCode, FhirEventTypeCode, FhirParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, Hl7v3EventTypeCode, Hl7v3ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, HpdEventTypeCode, HpdParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, IHEEventIdCode, MediaTypeCode, MllpEventTypeCode, MllpParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, SvsEventTypeCode, Xacml20EventTypeCodes, Xacml20ParticipantIdType, XdsEventTypeCode, XdsParticipantObjectIdTypeCode, XspaPoUCode
public interface EnumeratedCodedValue<T extends CodedValueType> extends EnumeratedValueSet<T>, CodedValueType
Represents an EnumeratedValueSet and serves as delegate to a CodedValueType. Enums that implement this interface can be used everywhere a CodedValueType is required.
